judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is a non-link footer img (alt="Our Funders") whose picture, per the crop and the screenshot, is two logos with text: the Irish harp with 'Rialtas na hÉireann / Government of Ireland' and 'pobal - government supporting communities'. claimTrue: as worded the sentence is not accurate, since 'Our Funders' is a collective label for the very organisations the image shows; the real defect is omission, not describing absent content. elementFails: the image conveys who the funders are, and the alternative names neither organisation, so it does not present equivalent information (G94); no visible text, caption, heading or adjacent text on the page names the funders either (the snapshot holds no 'Pobal' or 'Government of Ireland' text), and the image is not decorative or part of a link, so no technique makes it pass. captureDiffers: the live HTML fetched now has the same footer img, src and alt, and the screenshot is fully styled; the sticky header overlapping the screenshot does not touch this element. Read in good faith, the rubric counts 'describes something the image does not show' as naming an alternative that leaves out most of what the image conveys, so the label is true_positive.
